title: Inspect the Parent Node
goal: Chain weak pointer upgrade and interior mutability borrowing in sequence.
hints: Upgrade the Weak pointer to an Rc first using .upgrade()?.
Borrow the RefCell inside the returned Rc handle to reach the struct field.
explanation: Accessing data inside Weak<RefCell<Node>> requires two steps in exact order. First, call .upgrade()? on the Weak pointer to attempt upgrading it to Rc<RefCell<Node>>. If the referenced memory was already dropped, ? returns None immediately. Second, call .borrow() on the resulting Rc handle to acquire a read reference to the RefCell inner value. Attempting to call .borrow() directly on Weak fails with E0599.
